sourceTitle: Arizona Rules of Criminal Procedure, Rule 29.2
retrieval: Independent web open returned 403; independent focused search returned publisher indexed full rule text. No downloaded HTML bytes/hash claimed.

requirements.a: Application contents include applicant identity/address/DOB/signature, offenses, conviction place/date, sentence imposed, restitution/other monetary status and requested relief.
requirements.b: File in sentencing court; clerk may not charge a filing/docketing fee.
requirements.c: Court transmits application to the prosecutor within ten days after filing.
requirements.d: Prosecuting agency provides required victim notice.

distinction: Sentence imposed is distinct from sentence-compliance yes/no and from judgment date. Additional relief requested by the participant is distinct from the judge deciding whether to grant a certificate.
